research_question: Does the previously validated broad 30-day external residual overlay retain its diversified return and drawdown benefit when the complete V3 executed-buy set is frozen and entry liquidity is funded by substitution instead of skipping baseline orders?

data_contract.source_snapshot_note: Uses the currently retained same-end-date snapshots; the lambda-zero account and the original broad economic direction must reproduce before the result is accepted.
data_contract.entry_set_freeze: external information cannot create or remove a V3 buy; candidate replay keeps every baseline executed-buy signal-day, symbol and rank eligible
data_contract.liquidity_rule: when an externally extended position blocks a frozen V3 buy, fund the buy from the weakest prior-close ordinary position
data_contract.exit_timing: all protection decisions use prior close and execute next close

model.target: 30-day deferred-exit close return minus frozen mechanical-exit close return
model.target_availability: deferred label joins only after its exit day is strictly before the current decision
model.core_features: position path, rank and V3 entry price-volume features
model.full_features: core plus PIT global, SW L1, macro and official-event features
model.external_increment: full ridge prediction minus core ridge prediction

selection.standout_gate: at least 10 percent relative return improvement, or one fewer negative month together with improved drawdown
selection.robustness_requirement: formal pass still requires trigger concentration, leave-one-trigger-out and an untouched forward account window
